guide.how.crate: Shoot a supply crate in a Classic or Daily hunt
guide.how.crate_rifle: Shoot a supply crate in a Classic or Daily hunt while you carry a rifle ({guns})
guide.how.padstal: Buy it at the {stall} in a {run}: {price}
guide.how.rent: Rent it at the {stall} in a {run} for one hunt: {price}
guide.how.secret: Some farm secrets give it too
guide.effect.chilli_biltong: For {s} seconds your gun keeps firing while you hold, and the ammo never runs out.
guide.effect.boeretroos: For {s} seconds everything moves at {speed} speed.
guide.effect.bush_buckshot: Your next {n} shells spread {x}× wider, so a bunched flock is easier to hit.
guide.effect.meerkat_spotter: For {s} seconds a meerkat keeps watch and rings the farm's hidden secrets.
guide.effect.blitslaai: For {s} seconds every reload takes only {pct} % of the time.
guide.effect.oupa_laai: For {s} seconds Oupa loads for you: an empty gun reloads by itself, and a gun loaded shell by shell tops up after {idle} s without a shot.
guide.effect.rooikol: For {s} seconds your rifle aims through a red dot instead of its sight: no zooming in or out, it is ready the moment you press, and the time between shots is {pct} % of normal. No magnification, so far birds stay small — they can still be hit.
guide.effect.voorlaaier: An old muzzle-loader: {n} huge blasts of {p} pellets each, with a slow {r} s ramrod reload.
guide.effect.mielie_masjien: For {s} seconds hold to spray a fast stream of maize kernels, with no reloading.
guide.tip.chilli_biltong: Hold fire and sweep slowly across the flock.
guide.tip.boeretroos: Slow birds are easy birds: go for the far ones and the flyers.
guide.tip.bush_buckshot: Wait for birds to bunch up: one wide shell can bag a few.
guide.tip.meerkat_spotter: Pan around quickly: the rings show where the secrets are.
guide.tip.blitslaai: Shoot freely: an empty gun is full again in a blink.
guide.tip.oupa_laai: Keep shooting: Oupa has the reloading covered.
guide.tip.rooikol: Point and shoot: near and mid birds fall fast; far ones are small, so take your time on them.
guide.tip.voorlaaier: Save each blast for a big, tight flock.
guide.tip.mielie_masjien: Hold and sweep: it never needs a reload.
